summary: Iteration 3 verified the new autosave + undo/redo + replace-endpoint contract end-to-end. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py against the new bulk contract {saved:[{index,id}]}, the new /replace endpoints (snapshot+restore to avoid wiping real user data), and the group+item+shade keying for auto-status and balance-stock. 18/18 backend tests pass when run serially (pytest -n 0). Frontend Playwright validated: (a) typing autosaves within ~1s (SAVING SOON… -> SAVED) with no duplicate row on subsequent edits, (b) Ctrl+Z undoes, undone state persists on server, (c) Ctrl+R redoes without reloading the page and Ctrl+Shift+Z also redoes, (d) after a fresh reload UNDO/REDO buttons are disabled, (e) SR click cycles WHITE -> YELLOW row colour, (f) delete-row via UI removes the row and Ctrl+Z restores it, (g) In House Order sheet has only Group/Item/Shade/Quantity columns (no Conference), autosave+undo+delete work, (h) Balance Stock lists two lines for same item+shade in different groups (they do NOT net), balance is stock-ordered, SHORT ONLY toggle filters correctly, red row for negative balance, (i) sidebar nav labels rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform, mobile 390px shows menu toggle and dashboard stats.

minor.issue: StockRow model still carries a 'conference' field in server.py even though iteration 3 spec removed the Conference column from In House Order. Existing DB documents may still have this key; UI ignores it, tests do not assert against it. Consider removing from the model/BulkStockRows for cleanliness.

Aggregates stock per (group,item,shade) but does not deduct per-order demand across rows sharing the same key, so multiple order rows contending for the same limited stock can both flip to 'ready'. Confirmed via test that first row (need<=have) is ready and third (need>have) is arrived; product decision, not a defect.

action_items: Remove the vestigial 'conference' field from StockRow / StockRowIn in server.py to match the iteration 3 spec.

Note in docs that backend_test.py must be run with `pytest -n 0` because TestReplaceEndpoints wipes the shared collection and races with parallel workers under the pinned `-n 2 --dist loadscope` addopts. Non-blocking (all tests pass serially).
critical_code_review_comments: useSheet.step() calls pushWhole() which fires POST /replace on every undo/redo. On very large sheets (812 rows already exist), each keystroke undo re-inserts the entire collection. Consider a diff-based approach or debounce.
useSheet.pushHistory() snapshots the whole rows array before every applyPatch. Over long editing sessions this is O(N*history) memory (capped at 200 entries) — fine now, worth watching.

server.py auto_status endpoint aggregates stock but does not subtract already-satisfied order demand — two rows needing the same shade both get 'ready' if have >= each individual need. Document as intentional or fix.
server.py StockRow still has 'conference' although the iteration 3 spec removed it from the sheet; the field is silently ignored by the new UI but persisted on write from any stale client.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (rewritten for new bulk contract, added replace-endpoint snapshot/restore tests, group+item+shade auto-status test, group-differentiated balance-stock test)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use QA_ prefix rows/stock and clean up individually. Replace-endpoint tests snapshot GET /order-rows and /stock-rows and restore afterwards. Playwright tests use PW_ prefix and clean up. Real user data (812 order rows) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoints (iteration 3): POST /api/order-rows/bulk and /api/stock-rows/bulk return {saved:[{index,id}]}. POST /api/order-rows/replace and /api/stock-rows/replace WIPE the whole collection and reinsert -- if you write tests that call /replace with arbitrary payloads you MUST snapshot GET first and restore in a finally: block (there is real user data in the DB). Auto-status and balance-stock now key on Group+Item+Shade. Stock rows have no Conference column in the UI. Backend tests must be run with `pytest -n 0` because the pinned xdist config in /app/backend/pytest.ini (`-n 2 --dist loadscope`) races with the destructive /replace tests. Frontend testids to remember: cell-<r>-<key>, stock-cell-<r>-<key>, save-status, stock-save-status, undo-btn/redo-btn (plus stock-* variants), status-toggle-<r>, delete-row-<r>, only-short-btn, refresh-balance-btn, auto-status-btn. To add a new blank row in the Conference Order sheet through the UI you must edit the LAST row (useSheet appends a padding row when idx>=len-1); with 812 real rows already present, the safest UI approach is to seed a marker row via POST /api/order-rows/bulk, filter to isolate it, act on it, then delete via API to clean up.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. The initial pytest run under xdist -n 2 produced 2 spurious failures (auto-status and blank-rows-skipped) due to TestReplaceEndpoints running on a parallel worker and wiping the stock_rows/order_rows collections mid-test. Diagnosed by inspecting collection counts (813 vs 814) and observing not_ready when 'ready' was expected — matches the exact window when the other worker's /replace call was in-flight. Mitigation: run serially with -n 0; verified 18/18 pass.
